title: Answer: everything experiences, and which regions are someone is open

statements.text: Everything experiences: every vibe has a tone, and a tone is how that vibe feels. Being someone is another matter. A body and a rock are both crowds of vibes, and only the body is a self, a region whose vibes hang together as one. What makes a region one self is open: vibe explores whether it is the region that loses the most when cut, and on the working rule shared history gives no bounded self.
statements.scope: open. The premise is assumed, and every ledger row for selves is partial
